spec.description: Readings and device health for the Air Quality Sensor firmware 1.3.0. Metrics are the air_quality_* family exported on /metrics.

US EPA index derived from PM2.5. Bands: 0-50 good, 51-100 moderate, 101-150 unhealthy for sensitive groups, 151-200 unhealthy, 201-300 very unhealthy, above 300 hazardous. The firmware uses the table revised in February 2024, so the same concentration reads higher than it did before 1.0.
spec.title: Air Quality Index

spec.description: SGP30. The baseline is persisted, but the reading is relative and drifts.
spec.title: TVOC

spec.description: Station pressure is what the BMP180 reads. Sea level is that value corrected for the configured altitude.
spec.title: Pressure

spec.description: eCO2 is the SGP30 estimate from TVOC, not a measurement. It tracks the S8 loosely and is kept here to show when the two disagree.
spec.title: CO2

spec.description: Out of five: co2, tvoc, particulate, climate, pressure. A board without the SGP30 or the BMP180 sits at 3 by design, see the Device health row for which one is silent.
spec.title: Sensors reporting

spec.description: Particles per 0.1 L of air. Log scale: the two counts are orders of magnitude apart.
spec.title: Particle counts

spec.description: WHO puts the 24 h guideline at 15 ug/m3 and the annual one at 5. The dashed lines are 15 and the EPA unhealthy-for-sensitive-groups breakpoint at 35.4.
spec.title: PM2.5 rolling 24 h average

spec.description: Change over three hours, the reading a barometer needle gives. Falling faster than 3 hPa/3 h is the classic sign of an approaching front.
spec.title: Barometric tendency (3 h)

spec.description: One lane per sensor, from air_quality_sensor_up + air_quality_sensor_detected. Not wired means the sensor has never answered since boot, which is the normal state on a board without the SGP30 or the BMP180. Silent means it answered once and then stopped.
spec.title: Sensor availability

spec.description: Empty unless a battery is configured; it is off by default.
spec.title: Battery

spec.description: Free heap sliding down while fragmentation climbs is what precedes an allocation failure on the ESP8266.
spec.title: Heap

spec.description: Counts the millis() rollovers, so it keeps rising past 49.7 days. Firmware 1.1.0 and earlier reported that wrap as a reboot.
spec.title: Uptime

spec.description: Every drop in the uptime counter over the selected range.
spec.title: Reboots in range

spec.description: Derived from the standard atmosphere at 1013.25 hPa, so it moves with the weather. A rough indication, not a position, and not the station altitude used to reduce pressure.
spec.title: Barometric altitude

spec.description: 2024 EPA breakpoints. The fan is duty cycled, so this refreshes about every six minutes.
spec.title: PM2.5

spec.description: SenseAir S8. Above 1000 ppm the room needs air.
spec.title: CO2

spec.description: Station pressure reduced to sea level with the configured altitude. This is the figure comparable to a weather forecast.
spec.title: Pressure at sea level
Air Quality

spec.description: The device id label, set per station in the web UI.
spec.label: Station
